## Load Libraries

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("broom")
library("cowplot")
library("here") 
library("ggplot2")
library("ggrepel")
```

## Load data

```{r}
biopsy_data_file <- here("data", "biopsy.csv")
if(dir.exists("data")) {
    print("data directory already exists")
  } else {
    print("Creating data directory")
    dir.create(path = "data")
  }
  
if(file.exists(biopsy_data_file)) {
    print("biopsy.csv already exists, loading data")
  
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = biopsy_data_file, 
                          show_col_types = FALSE)
  } else {
    print("Retriving data")
    
    # Retrieve the data
    biopsy_data <- read_csv(file = "https://wilkelab.org/classes/SDS348/data_sets/biopsy.csv",
                            show_col_types = FALSE)

    # Write the data to disk
    write_csv(x = biopsy_data, file = biopsy_data_file)
  }
```

## Analysis

### Applying PCA model

```{r}
pca_fit <- biopsy_data |> 
  select(where(is.numeric)) |> 
  prcomp(scale = TRUE)
```

### 2D data representation in PC coordinates

```{r}
# Extract explained variance for PC1 and PC2
explained_var <- pca_fit |> 
  tidy(matrix = "eigenvalues") |> 
  select(1, 2) |> 
  pluck(percent)

# 2D scatter plot of data projected onto the two major principle components
pca_fit |> 
  augment(biopsy) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = .fittedPC1,
             y = .fittedPC2,
             color = outcome,
             shape = outcome)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5,
             alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "PC1",
       y = "PC2",
       title = "Breast cancer biopsy data projected on PCs")
```

```{r}
# charlot
# define arrow style for plotting
arrow_style <- arrow(
  angle = 20, ends = "first", type = "closed", length = grid::unit(8, "pt")
)

# plot rotation matrix
pca_fit |>
  tidy(matrix = "rotation") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = "PC", names_prefix = "PC", values_from = "value") |>
  ggplot(aes(PC1, PC2)) +
  geom_segment(xend = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow_style) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = column),
    hjust = 1, nudge_x = -0.02, 
    color = "#904C2F"
  ) +
  xlim(-1.25, .5) + ylim(-.5, 1) +
  coord_fixed() + # fix aspect ratio to 1:1
  theme_minimal_grid(12)
```
